business.name: Harbour Finch Café
business.tagline: Coffee, baking and a seat by the window.
business.address: 36 Birch Quay, Dartmouth, NS B2Y 1H6, Canada

pages.title: Harbour Finch Café
pages.description: Small-batch coffee, fresh baking and simple lunches in downtown Dartmouth. Drop into Harbour Finch Café seven days a week.

sections.heading: A warm welcome on the Dartmouth waterfront
sections.text: Start your morning with a carefully pulled espresso and something fresh from the oven. Stay for lunch, bring a book or take your coffee down to the harbour.

image.alt: A welcoming café with tables beside large windows

items.title: Coffee with care
items.description: Espresso drinks and filter coffee made with beans from a small Nova Scotia roaster. Oat milk is always available.

items.title: Baked every morning
items.description: Buttery pastries, oat cookies and seasonal muffins made in our kitchen. The selection changes with the day.

items.title: A simple, good lunch
items.description: Soup, toasties and fresh sandwiches from 11:00 until sold out. Ask us about today's vegetarian option.

sections.heading: Our little spot by the harbour
sections.text: Friends Leah MacDonald and Sam Ortiz opened Harbour Finch in 2021 with one idea: make the neighbourhood's daily coffee feel special. We buy locally where we can and bake in small batches to keep things fresh.

images.alt: Freshly prepared coffee ready to serve
Golden pastries from a morning bake

sections.heading: See you at the café
sections.text: No booking needed for everyday visits. For groups of six or more, give us a call so we can help you find a good time.

pages.title: Menu
pages.description: Coffee, pastries and lunch at Harbour Finch Café. Browse our everyday menu and Canadian-dollar prices before your Dartmouth visit.

sections.heading: Good things, made simply
sections.text: Prices are in Canadian dollars, before tax. Baking and lunch specials change daily; our team can tell you what is fresh today.

items.name: Espresso
items.description: A balanced double shot from our house blend.

items.name: Cappuccino
items.description: Double espresso with steamed milk, 8 oz.

items.name: Latte
items.description: Double espresso with steamed milk, 12 oz. Oat milk adds $0.50.

items.name: Loose-leaf tea
items.description: Choose black, green or herbal tea.

items.name: Butter croissant
items.description: Flaky, golden and baked every morning.

items.name: Seasonal muffin
items.description: Ask about today's fruit and spice combination.

items.name: Cheddar toastie
items.description: Aged cheddar and onion relish on sourdough.

items.name: Soup and bread
items.description: A warming bowl with a slice of sourdough. Available from 11:00.

items.question: Do you have vegan or gluten-free options?
items.answer: We usually have a vegan bake and can prepare several drinks with oat milk. Our shared kitchen handles wheat, milk, eggs and nuts, so we cannot guarantee an allergen-free item. Speak with our team before ordering.

items.question: Can I order baking for a meeting?
items.answer: Yes. Email at least two working days ahead with the date, number of people and any dietary requests. We will confirm availability and a price before you order.

pages.title: Visit
pages.description: Find Harbour Finch Café in downtown Dartmouth, check opening hours and get in touch about a group visit or baking order.

sections.heading: Come on in
sections.text: Our café has a step-free entrance, indoor tables and a small outdoor seating area in warm weather. Bicycle parking is nearby. Well-behaved dogs are welcome at outdoor tables.
